The '''2018 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 7 August to 9 December 2018.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2018_cla_cs.pdf|title=EL CALENDARIO DE AMBOS TORNEOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2018 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2018-espanol.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish|access-date=2017-12-31|archive-date=2018-05-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180516165759/http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2018-espanol.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

===Seeding===
<section begin=Seeding />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*Each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 23).
*In the round of 16, quarterfinals, and semifinals, if tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 29).
*In the finals, if tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was not used, and 30 minutes of extra time were played. If still tied after extra time, a penalty shoot-out was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 30).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 4 June 2018, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/el-4-de-junio-se-sortean-los-octavos-de-la-libertadores-y-segunda-fase-de-la-sudamericana|title=El 4 de junio se sortean los Octavos de la Libertadores y Segunda Fase de la Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=19 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/cruces-estelares-tras-el-sorteo-de-los-octavos-de-final|title=Cruces estelares tras el sorteo de los Octavos de Final|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=4 June 2018}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/pauta_sorteo_libertadores_2018.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018, SISTEMA DE SORTEO – Octavos de Final|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Finals==
{{main article|2018 Copa Libertadores Finals}}

In the finals, if tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was not used, and 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] were played. If still tied after extra time, a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 30).<ref name="regulations"/>

The first leg was played on 11 November (originally scheduled on 10 November, but postponed due to rain), and the second leg was played on 9 December 2018 (originally scheduled on 24 November, but postponed due to safety concerns following [[2018 Copa Libertadores Finals#Incidents|an attack on the Boca Juniors team bus]] prior to the original scheduled match).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/las-finales-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-se-disputaran-el-10-y-24-de-noviembre|title=Las finales de la CONMEBOL Libertadores se disputarán el 10 y 24 de noviembre|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=1 November 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/confirmados-los-horarios-y-fechas-de-los-partidos-finales-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2018|title=Confirmados los horarios y fechas de los partidos finales de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2018|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 November 2018}}</ref>
